gloss_en: cloud (עָנָן) — the meteorological/theophanic cloud mass, as in the cloud of divine glory and the rain-bearing cloud; symbolically the aspect of Yitzchak (darkness/dimmed sight) and of a garment ('He made the cloud its garment'); not the personal name Anan and not עוֹנֵן/מְעוֹנֵן (to practice soothsaying)
